recommendations: Run the trigonometry strand t01 to t16 in outline order after e08. t01 opens on e08's final frame (the square of side 1, the equilateral triangle of side 2 halved, and sin 45° = 0.7071...); t16 hands on to g01.

Degrees first, radians at t08: the site teaches radians (lesson01) and the unit circle in radians (lesson03) before exact values and quadrants, but the 2024 syllabus groups degrees work under "Trigonometry with angles of any magnitude". t03 and t04 use the site numbers converted to degrees, and t08 reuses the radian forms.

Shared points: `ci96840b09` (proofs) and `ci5fb5a13c` (applications) are split: t05 owns the sine rule, the area formula and degrees and minutes; t06 owns the cosine rule and the non-right bearings journey; t07 owns the ambiguous case (`ci44ad375d`) and choosing a rule.

Year 12 entry knowledge is delivered by: t08 (`ciccaa78be`, conversions and exact values at multiples of π/6 and π/4), t10 (`cid79268a8`, graphs of sin, cos and tan in degrees and radians with period, amplitude, asymptotes and symmetry) and t15 with t16 (solving trig equations on a restricted domain, by quadrants and by counting, with a calculator in radian mode).

Missing or partial site coverage needing original teaching: circle of radius r definitions (t03, t12), multiples of 90° from the definitions (t03), the three negative-angle results together (t04), the ambiguous-case condition b sin A < a < b (t07), a major sector or segment example (t09), graphs in degrees (t10), sec, cosec and cot as side ratios and at 0° and 90° (t11), and per-identity excluded angles (t12, t13).

Possible splits if drafts run long: t12 (definitions and exclusions apart from exact values), t14 (proving the three identities apart from proving further identities) and t15 (single angles apart from multiple angles). No merges recommended.
Eight new copy errors (S11-11 to S11-18) and a minor list are added to site-corrections-maths-a11.md section 7; each has its old text and correction in section 8 of the named pack.
covers: math-a11-t01 to math-a11-t16 (Trigonometry and measure of angles; Trigonometric identities and equations)

entries.startBoundary: Open on t15's handoff (the site's hook): 2 sin² θ − sin θ − 1 = 0, with each sin θ glowing and the chip "call it s?".
entries.stopBoundary: Solve trigonometric equations that reduce to quadratics on a restricted domain: substitute one ratio (s = sin θ), solve the quadratic, reject a root outside −1 ≤ s ≤ 1 for sin or cos with a stated reason (tan takes every value), and solve each surviving root as in t15; reduce a mixed equation to one ratio with sin² θ = 1 − cos² θ (or the reverse), converting towards the ratio that appears unsquared; factorise rather than divide (sin² θ = sin θ). Degrees and radians. This ends the trigonometry strand; graph transformations (g01) come next.
